description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelTopScheduleCallButton, which extends a button class for rendering a subpanel button. The class provides methods to generate a form for scheduling calls and to display the button, integrating with SugarCRM/SuiteCRM subpanel UI components.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopScheduleCallButton
classes.description: A widget class for rendering a 'Schedule Call' button in a subpanel, allowing users to create scheduled calls directly from a subpanel view.

methods.name: _get_form
methods.description: Generates an HTML form for scheduling a call, including hidden fields with context-specific information and JavaScript for submission.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Determines if the button should be displayed based on access rights and returns the button HTML or an empty string.
